sentences.text: The Federal Republic of Nigeria -LSB- naɪˈdʒɪəriə -RSB- , commonly referred to as Nigeria , is a federal republic in West Africa , bordering Benin in the west , Chad and Cameroon in the east , and Niger in the north .	Niger	Niger	Federal	Federation	republic	republic	federal	Federation	West Africa	West Africa	Benin	Benin	Chad	Chad	Cameroon	Cameroon	Africa	Africa
Its coast in the south lies on the Gulf of Guinea in the Atlantic Ocean .	Gulf of Guinea	Gulf of Guinea	Atlantic Ocean	Atlantic Ocean

It comprises 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory , where the capital , Abuja is located .	Abuja	Abuja	Federal	Federation	36 states	States of Nigeria	Federal Capital Territory	Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria	capital	Capital city
Nigeria is officially a democratic secular country .	officially	Constitution of Nigeria	democratic	Democracy	secular country	Secular state
Modern-day Nigeria has been the site of numerous kingdoms and tribal states over the millennia .

The modern state originated from British colonial rule beginning in the 19th century , and the merging of the Southern Nigeria Protectorate and Northern Nigeria Protectorate in 1914 .	Southern	Protectorate of Southern Nigeria	Northern Nigeria	Protectorate of Northern Nigeria	Southern Nigeria Protectorate	Southern Nigeria Protectorate	Northern Nigeria Protectorate	Northern Nigeria Protectorate
The British set up administrative and legal structures whilst practising indirect rule through traditional chiefdoms .	indirect rule	indirect rule	chiefdoms	chiefdoms
Nigeria became a formally independent federation in 1960 , and plunged into a civil war from 1967 to 1970 .	civil war	Nigerian Civil War

It has since alternated between democratically elected civilian governments and military dictatorships , until it achieved a stable democracy in 1999 , with the 2011 presidential elections considered the first to be reasonably free and fair .	presidential	Presidential system	2011 presidential elections	Nigerian presidential election, 2011
Nigeria is often referred to as the `` Giant of Africa '' , owing to its large population and economy .	Africa	Africa

With approximately 184 million inhabitants , Nigeria is the most populous country in Africa and the seventh most populous country in the world .	most populous country	List of African countries by population	Africa	Africa	seventh most populous country in the world	list of countries by population
Nigeria has one of the largest populations of youth in the world .	populations of youth	Youth in Nigeria

The country is viewed as a multinational state , as it is inhabited by over 500 ethnic groups , of which the three largest are the Hausa , Igbo and Yoruba ; these ethnic groups speak over 500 different languages , and are identified with wide variety of cultures .	Hausa	Hausa people	Igbo	Odinani	Yoruba	Yoruba religion	multinational state	multinational state
The official language is English .	English	English language
Nigeria is divided roughly in half between Christians , who live mostly in the southern part of the country , and Muslims in the northern part .	Christians	Christianity	Muslims	Islam
A minority of the population practise religions indigenous to Nigeria , such as those native to the Igbo and Yoruba ethnicities .	Igbo	Odinani	Yoruba	Yoruba religion

, Nigeria is the world 's 20th largest economy , worth more than $ 500 billion and $ 1 trillion in terms of nominal GDP and purchasing power parity respectively .	20th	List of countries by GDP (PPP)	nominal GDP	nominal GDP	purchasing power parity	purchasing power parity
It overtook South Africa to become Africa 's largest economy in 2014 .	Africa	Africa	South Africa	South Africa
The 2013 debt-to-GDP ratio was 11 percent .	debt-to-GDP ratio	debt-to-GDP ratio

Nigeria is considered to be an emerging market by the World Bank ; it has been identified as a regional power on the African continent , a middle power in international affairs , and has also been identified as an emerging global power .	emerging market	Emerging markets	World Bank	World Bank	regional power	regional power	middle power	middle power	emerging global power	emerging power

It is also listed among the `` Next Eleven '' economies set to become among the biggest in the world .	Next Eleven	Next Eleven
